verses.en: For Zion’s sake will I not hold my peace, and for Jerusalem’s sake I will not rest, until the righteousness thereof go forth as brightness, and the salvation thereof as a lamp that burneth.
verses.pt: Por Sião eu não me calarei, e por Jerusalém não me aquietarei, enquanto sua justiça não sair como um brilho, e sua salvação como uma tocha acesa.
verses.en_web: For Zion’s sake will I not hold my peace, and for Jerusalem’s sake I will not rest, until her righteousness shines out like the dawn, and her salvation like a burning lamp.
verses.en_bbe: Because of Zion I will not keep quiet, and because of Jerusalem I will take no rest, till her righteousness goes out like the shining of the sun, and her salvation like a burning light.

verses.en: And the Gentiles shall see thy righteousness, and all kings thy glory: and thou shalt be called by a new name, which the mouth of the LORD shall name.
verses.pt: E as nações verão tua justiça, e todos os reis verão tua glória; e te chamarão por um novo nome, que a boca do SENHOR determinará.
verses.en_web: The nations will see your righteousness, and all kings your glory, and you will be called by a new name, which Yahweh‘s mouth will name.
verses.en_bbe: And the nations will see your righteousness, and all kings your glory: and you will have a new name, given by the mouth of the Lord.

verses.en: Thou shalt also be a crown of glory in the hand of the LORD, and a royal diadem in the hand of thy God.
verses.pt: E serás coroa de glória na mão do SENHOR, e diadema real na mão de teu Deus.
verses.en_web: You will also be a crown of beauty in Yahweh‘s hand, and a royal diadem in your God‘s hand.
verses.en_bbe: And you will be a fair crown in the hand of the Lord, and a king's head-dress in the hand of your God.

verses.en: Thou shalt no more be termed Forsaken; neither shall thy land any more be termed Desolate: but thou shalt be called Hephzi-bah, and thy land Beulah: for the LORD delighteth in thee, and thy land shall be married.
verses.pt: Nunca mais te chamarão de abandonada, nem se referirão mais a tua terra como assolada; mas sim te chamarão de: “Nela Está Meu Prazer”, e à tua terra de “A Casada”, porque o SENHOR se agrade de ti, e tua terra se casará.
verses.en_web: You will not be called Forsaken any more; nor will your land be called Desolate any more: but you will be called Hephzibah, and your land Beulah; for Yahweh delights in you, and your land will be married.
verses.en_bbe: You will not now be named, She who is given up; and your land will no longer be named, The waste land: but you will have the name, My pleasure is in her, and your land will be named, Married: for the Lord has pleasure in you, and your land will be married.

verses.en: For as a young man marrieth a virgin, so shall thy sons marry thee: and as the bridegroom rejoiceth over the bride, so shall thy God rejoice over thee.
verses.pt: Porque tal como o rapaz se casa com a virgem, assim também teus filhos se casarão contigo; e como o noivo se alegra da noiva, assim o teu Deus se alegrará de ti.
verses.en_web: For as a young man marries a virgin, so your sons will marry you. As a bridegroom rejoices over his bride, so your God will rejoice over you.
verses.en_bbe: For as a young man takes a virgin for his wife, so will your maker be married to you: and as a husband has joy in his bride, so will the Lord your God be glad over you.

verses.en: I have set watchmen upon thy walls, O Jerusalem, which shall never hold their peace day nor night: ye that make mention of the LORD, keep not silence,
verses.pt: Jerusalém, obre os teus muros eu pus guardas, que o dia todo e a noite toda continuamente não se calarão; vós que fazeis menção do SENHOR, não haja silêncio em vós;
verses.en_web: I have set watchmen on your walls, Jerusalem. They will never be silent day nor night. You who call on Yahweh, take no rest,
verses.en_bbe: I have put watchmen on your walls, O Jerusalem; they will not keep quiet day or night: you who are the Lord's recorders, take no rest,

verses.en: And give him no rest, till he establish, and till he make Jerusalem a praise in the earth.
verses.pt: Nem deis descanso a ele, até que ele estabeleça, até que ele ponha a Jerusalém como louvor na terra.
verses.en_web: and give him no rest, until he establishes, and until he makes Jerusalem a praise in the earth.
verses.en_bbe: And give him no rest, till he puts Jerusalem in her place to be praised in the earth.

verses.en: The LORD hath sworn by his right hand, and by the arm of his strength, Surely I will no more give thy corn to be meat for thine enemies; and the sons of the stranger shall not drink thy wine, for the which thou hast laboured:
verses.pt: O SENHOR jurou por sua mão direita e pelo seu forte braço: Nunca mais darei teu trigo como comida a teus inimigos, nem estrangeiros beberão teu suco da uva em que trabalhaste.
verses.en_web: Yahweh has sworn by his right hand, and by the arm of his strength, “Surely I will no more give your grain to be food for your enemies; and foreigners will not drink your new wine, for which you have labored;
verses.en_bbe: The Lord has taken an oath by his right hand, and by the arm of his strength, Truly, I will no longer give your grain to be food for your haters; and men of strange countries will not take the wine for which your work has been done:

verses.en: But they that have gathered it shall eat it, and praise the LORD; and they that have brought it together shall drink it in the courts of my holiness.
verses.pt: Mas sim aqueles que o ajuntarem o comerão, e louvarão ao SENHOR; e os que o colherem beberão nos pátios do meu santuário.
verses.en_web: but those who have harvested it will eat it, and praise Yahweh; and those who have gathered it will drink it in the courts of my sanctuary.”
verses.en_bbe: But those who have got in the grain will have it for their food, and will give praise to the Lord; and those who have got in the grapes will take the wine of them in the open places of my holy house.

verses.en: Go through, go through the gates; prepare ye the way of the people; cast up, cast up the highways; gather out the stones; lift up a standard for the people.
verses.pt: Passai! Passai pelas portas! Preparai o caminho ao povo! Aplanai! Aplanai a estrada, limpai -a das pedras! Levantai uma bandeira aos povos!
verses.en_web: Go through, go through the gates! Prepare the way of the people! Build up, build up the highway! Gather out the stones! Lift up a banner for the peoples.
verses.en_bbe: Go through, go through the doors; make ready the way of the people; let the highway be lifted up; let the stones be taken away; let a flag be lifted up over the peoples.

verses.en: Behold, the LORD hath proclaimed unto the end of the world, Say ye to the daughter of Zion, Behold, thy salvation cometh; behold, his reward is with him, and his work before him.
verses.pt: Eis que o SENHOR fez ouvir até a extremidade da terra: Dizei à filha de Sião: eis que tua salvação está vindo; eis que traz sua recompensa consigo, e seu pagamento vem diante dele.
verses.en_web: Behold, Yahweh has proclaimed to the end of the earth, “Say to the daughter of Zion, ‘Behold, your salvation comes. Behold, his reward is with him, and his recompense before him.’”
verses.en_bbe: The Lord has sent out word to the end of the earth, Say to the daughter of Zion, See, your saviour comes; those whom he has made free are with him, and those to whom he has given salvation go before him.

verses.en: And they shall call them, The holy people, The redeemed of the LORD: and thou shalt be called, Sought out, A city not forsaken.
verses.pt: E os chamarão de povo santo, redimidos do SENHOR; e tu serás chamada “A Procurada, a Cidade Não Desemparada”.
verses.en_web: They will call them The holy people, Yahweh’s redeemed. You will be called Sought out, A city not forsaken.
verses.en_bbe: And they will be named, The holy people, Those whose cause has been taken up by the Lord: and you will be named, Desired, A town not given up.
